title: nf-austin/scArches pipeline parameters
description: Automated scArches-based integration and label transfer.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Query datasets to map, and where results go.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV listing the QUERY datasets to map.
input.help_text: Columns: `sample` and `h5ad`. The reference atlas is separate -- pass it via `--train_h5ad`. Mutually exclusive with `--h5ad_dir`.

h5ad_dir.description: Ad-hoc alternative: a glob matching query .h5ad files.

outdir.description: Output directory. Use an absolute path on a cluster or on cloud storage.

model_options.title: Model options
model_options.description: Train a reference model, or reuse one.

train_model.description: Train a reference model from --train_h5ad. Set false to reuse an existing archive.

train_h5ad.description: Reference atlas to train on. Required when --train_model is true.

model_tarball.description: Trained model archive to reuse. Required when --train_model is false.
model_tarball.help_text: Defaults to `<outdir>/<model_name>.tar.gz`, which only resolves when a previous run wrote there. On Seqera Platform, where each run gets a fresh scratch directory, pass this explicitly.

model_type.description: Model architecture. SCVI has no native classifier and always uses the weighted-KNN.

model_name.description: Name of the model directory and archive.

celltype_obs.description: obs column holding the reference cell type labels.

dataset_obs.description: obs column identifying batches/datasets. Blank treats the reference as one batch.

n_hvgs.description: Highly variable genes used for training.

min_dataset_detection.description: Fraction of --dataset_obs levels a gene must be detected in to survive into training.
min_dataset_detection.help_text: 1.0 requires every dataset, i.e. the intersection of their panels. A reference stitched from sub-atlases by an outer join keeps genes present in only some sources and zero-fills the rest; the model then learns those structural zeros as sub-atlas discriminators. 0 disables, as does leaving --dataset_obs blank.

min_gene_overlap.description: Fraction of the reference gene panel that must be present in a query before mapping it.
min_gene_overlap.help_text: scArches' surgery silently zero-fills missing genes, and that padding hits low-UMI cell types hardest, so a poor overlap shows up as confident-but-wrong label transfer rather than an error. 0 disables the check.

finetune_epochs.description: SCANVI fine-tuning epochs after SCVI pretraining.

integrate_max_epochs.description: Max epochs for APPLY_MODEL's query mapping.

batch_size.description: Minibatch size for TRAIN_MODEL, over the whole reference.

integrate_batch_size.description: Minibatch size for APPLY_MODEL, per query sample.
integrate_batch_size.help_text: Deliberately smaller than the reference batch size: a query file holds one sample, so a reference-scale batch leaves the surgery only a few hundred gradient steps and the query lands wherever the frozen encoder puts it.

n_samples_per_label.description: SCANVI fine-tuning: cells sampled per label per epoch (0 = off).

max_cells_per_label.description: Cap on reference cells per label when fitting the weighted-KNN (0 = all).

use_knn.description: Transfer labels with the weighted-KNN instead of the model's native classifier.

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Which image the processes run in.

scarches_container_any.description: Pin a specific image, overriding the automatic CPU/GPU selection.

execution_options.title: Execution environment
execution_options.description: GPU, cluster scheduler, image caches and bind mounts.
execution_options.help_text: Use the `slurm` profile together with an engine profile: `-profile slurm,singularity`.

use_gpu.description: Train and apply on GPU. Selects the CUDA image and requests an accelerator.
use_gpu.help_text: On SLURM the GPU is requested via --gpu_cluster_options, because that executor ignores Nextflow's `accelerator` directive. Under Docker this adds --gpus all; under Singularity, --nv.

gpu_cluster_options.description: sbatch options used to request a GPU when --use_gpu is set.
gpu_cluster_options.help_text: Adjust to match your site, e.g. '--gres=gpu:a100:1'. Combined with --cluster_options rather than replacing it.

slurm_queue.help_text: Only used with `-profile slurm`. Left unset, no --partition flag is emitted and the cluster default applies.

cluster_options.description: Raw sbatch options appended to every job, e.g. '--qos=long'.

singularity_cache_dir.description: Shared directory for pulled Singularity images.
singularity_cache_dir.help_text: Put this on shared storage the compute nodes can read. $HOME is quota-limited and is not always mounted on compute nodes.

conda_cache_dir.description: Shared directory for created conda environments.

singularity_bind.description: Extra paths to bind into the container, comma-separated, e.g. '/mnt/gpfs,/scratch'.
singularity_bind.help_text: autoMounts only binds paths Nextflow itself resolved. HPC filesystems are routinely symlinked, which shows up as 'file not found' inside the container even though the host path exists.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum time for any single job.

help.description: Print the help message and exit.
